instagram.body:
Open design is officially here. Expect a lot more of this as people get ahold of AI tools that can clone process fast. No more claude design I guess 🙃
Do you have FOMO from every single designer using Claude code to pump out amazing designs and you just don't want to spend the tokens to learn it? Well, have I got a library for you! Honestly, I'm definitely going to give this a try because it looks really great, and it's fully local, so I'm into that. And the designs that it pumps out are, you know, pretty decent. So one thing to look out for, because everybody's going to eventually get a hold of these things and everybody's going to have these tools. Right now, it's a weird time because not a lot of people know how to use this stuff, so you don't see a lot of this stuff. But it's basically going to turn into templates. So if you guys want to do the whole template phase of web design where all of a sudden every website got way better, there was a reason for that, everybody was using templates. But guess what? In 2026, when you look at one of those template sites, like, you know, you know when you're looking at a, like a Nike website versus something that was just templated and a mom and pop shop, right away, without even knowing what brand it is. It's going to happen to these too. Mark my words. I mean, these designs look really decent right now, but eventually, everything's going to look like this. So, even though you have these tools, learn design. Learn what a good design system is. Learn how to design grids. Learn how to interpret feedback and then put it into your design, and then have a very specific brand in mind when you're designing your website. It's going to build trust with your users. So try it out, let me know how it goes, and save this video for later so you can come back to this if you're not going to do it right now, and give me a follow, because I share tools like this every single day. All right, see you in the next one. Peace.
